    },

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A code and build change that also updates its documentation belongs to the respective functional area, not docs."
    },

      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "contrib/devtools/shell-win64-cross.nix is a build and developer environment definition, which falls under the build category.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Build and release scripts are covered by build rather than tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
